narrativeProgression.description: Kathy is introduced as a candidate for Commonwealth Court Judge from Bucks County.
Kathy shares her background as an attorney and her work experience in civil rights and voting rights.
Kathy mentions her education at the University of Pennsylvania and American University Law School.
Kathy is acknowledged as the only candidate recommended by the State Bar Association on the Democratic side.
Kathy explains the role of the Commonwealth Court within the Pennsylvania court system.
Kathy highlights the everyday relevance of the Commonwealth Court by mentioning cases related to unemployment compensation, workers' compensation, and environmental law.
The conversation shifts to the underrepresentation of women and minorities in Pennsylvania's statewide appellate courts.
Kathy acknowledges the progress made in electing women to judicial positions but emphasizes the need for further improvement.
Kathy highlights Pennsylvania's low ranking regarding women's representation in the judiciary.
Kathy reflects on the challenges faced by women and minorities in pursuing political office.
Kathy shares details about her personal life, including her husband and daughter.
